description: Operational view of signals that complement signed W9 qualification evidence. This dashboard is not the evidence artifact.

panels.description: Signed W9 evidence must cover real-driver scale envelopes, bounded memory, model traces, PII canaries, tenant isolation, licenses, SBOM and byte-for-byte reproducibility. Metric absence cannot satisfy any of those gates.

options.content:
## Qualification evidence boundary

Record the exact commit, workload dimensions, tool and driver versions, input digests, measured outputs, bottlenecks, model results and honest limitations in a closed canonical schema. Sign under a W9-specific signature domain. Keep private keys outside the repository and keep machine paths, hostnames, tenant data and message data out of evidence.

panels.description: Runtime-backed rules: blob integrity failure, unknown dispatch rate, oldest due work, raw orphans increasing, stale dispatching rows, legal-hold deletion attempts, binding evidence expiry, route-gap drift, scratch age, nonce cleanup lag, retention lag and evidence near expiry. Signed evidence gates: tenant isolation, backup and restore verification, telemetry leakage canary.

options.content:
## Coverage status

All metric-backed Prometheus alerts have verified runtime or collector producers. Tenant isolation, backup and restore verification, and telemetry leakage remain signed-evidence gates. See `observability/alerts/coverage.v1.json` for the complete rationale and `observability/runbooks/alerts.md` for safe diagnosis.
